messages:
lena: hey friends — two quick life updates: 1) Pat and I eloped in Joshua Tree last weekend (very small, very windy, very us) 🌵💍 2) i accepted the Staff Engineer role — still pinching myself. low-key celebrating friday on the rooftop at 6pm if anyone wants to swing by. tacos or pizza? bring +1s ok? also, we have two indoor cats so please no cut flowers 🙏

rasha: OMG CONGRATS x2!! 🥳 so happy for you both. will bring napkins and bad dad jokes. tacos pls.

omar: huge congrats lena!! staff is deserved. i can bring a speaker and a playlist. also yes to tacos.

june: congratulations!! can i bring my +1? we might bring our toddler — is that alright?

lena: @june yes kids totally welcome. we'll set aside a corner and some juice boxes. thanks for asking!

anika: congrats!!! want to see photos if you're comfy sharing 🥰

lena: posted a few here: https://photos.app.g/placeholder — just candids, nothing formal.

kyle: double congrats!! also: tacos > pizza (fight me) 🌮 :tada:

sara: adding to the logistics thread: rooftop capacity ~30, starts at 6pm, we'll aim to order food at 5:15 so it arrives by 6:15. feel free to RSVP here.

lena: no registry but if anyone asks we love small houseplants or coffee shop gift cards (cats + plants tricky, so low-tox/planter welcome).

omar: RSVP: me +1. can help grab extra chairs.

rasha: RSVP: me (solo). bringing tres leches cupcake situation.

june: RSVP: me + toddler. bringing fruit tray.

anika: RSVP: me + partner. bringing chips/salsa.

kyle: RSVP: me. bringing the playlist and blankets.

sara: noted on food timing. adding to calendar and pinging facilities for extra trash bins.

mike-bot: calendar event created: "Lena & Pat + promotion rooftop hang" Fri 18:00 — invites sent to channel.

lena: thanks everyone — cannot wait to celebrate in person. and thanks for all the congrats, it means a lot 💛
